description: Pod restarts, CrashLoopBackOff, CPU, memory, availability and failures on AKS (Azure managed Prometheus)

panels.title: Pods
panels.description: Pods in the current selection

targets.expr: count(count by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Pods in Running phase

targets.expr: count((max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == 1))

panels.title: Pod Availability
panels.description: Running pods whose Ready condition is true

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == 1)) / count((max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == 1))

panels.title: Restarts (time range)
panels.description: Container restarts across the dashboard's time range

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])))

panels.title: CrashLoopBackOff
panels.description: Containers in CrashLoopBackOff right now

targets.expr: count(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed Pods
panels.description: Pods currently in Failed phase

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Failed", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Restarts Over Time
panels.description: Container restarts per pod in each interval. Only pods that restarted are shown.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0

panels.title: Top Restarting Containers (time range)
panels.description: Restarts across the dashboard time range, with the reason the container last terminated (OOMKilled, Error, Completed…)

targets.expr: (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) > 0) * on (cluster, namespace, pod, container) group_left(reason) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} == 1) or on (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: CrashLoopBackOff Containers by Namespace
panels.description: Containers in CrashLoopBackOff over time

targets.expr: count by (cluster, namespace) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} == 1)

panels.title: CrashLoopBackOff Pods (now)
panels.description: Containers currently in CrashLoopBackOff, with total restarts and the last termination reason

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) * on (cluster, namespace, pod, container) group_left() (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} == 1) * on (cluster, namespace, pod, container) group_left(reason) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} == 1)

panels.title: Pod CPU Usage (top $topn)
panels.description: CPU cores used per pod

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: CPU Throttling % (top $topn)
panels.description: Share of CFS periods in which the pod hit its CPU limit. Sustained values above 25% usually mean the CPU limit is too low.

targets.expr: topk($topn, 100 * sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Pod Memory Working Set (top $topn)
panels.description: Working-set memory per pod, the figure the OOM killer uses

targets.expr: topk($topn, sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Memory % of Limit (top $topn)
panels.description: Working set as a share of the pod's memory limit. At 100% the container is OOMKilled. Pods without limits are not shown.

targets.expr: topk($topn, 100 * sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) / sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}))

panels.title: Pod Resource Usage (top 50 by CPU)
panels.description: Current usage against requests and limits. Empty request/limit cells mean none is set.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))
sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

100 * sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) / sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})
sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Pod Availability % by Namespace
panels.description: Share of Running pods that are Ready

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (cluster, namespace) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == 1)) / count by (cluster, namespace) ((max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == 1))

panels.title: Deployment Availability
panels.description: Ready vs desired replicas for each deployment in the selected namespaces, lowest availability first

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
max by (cluster, namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})

100 * max by (cluster, namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) / (max by (cluster, namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) > 0)

panels.title: Pods by Phase
panels.description: Pod count per phase over time

targets.expr: sum by (phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Failed Pods by Namespace
panels.description: Pods in Failed phase over time, per namespace

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Failed", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) > 0

panels.title: Failed Pods (now)
panels.description: Pods currently in Failed phase and the node they ran on

targets.expr: (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Failed", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} == 1) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(node, created_by_kind, created_by_name) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node, created_by_kind, created_by_name) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})

title: Pods – AKS
